basePrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: One production dialogue character sprite for the Chinese wuxia PC game 活侠传 / Legend of Mortal, Zhao Huo, new HANDSOME optional variant.
Image 1 is the original game's sprite: reference for identity cues, clothing, proportions, rough painted rendering. Image 2 is the existing natural-beautification sprite and is the EDIT TARGET for pose, clothing and exact complete silhouette.
Primary request: Make this visibly a handsome, charismatic young Chinese martial artist, distinctly more handsome and more masculine than image 2. Redesign ONLY the face: longer well-proportioned face, defined but believable jaw and cheekbones, straight elegant nose, confident slightly narrow dark almond eyes, strong straight sword-like eyebrows, restrained warm half-smile. Clean-shaven, age early/mid twenties, lightly sun-tanned skin. Handsome heroic wuxia illustrated-book protagonist, believable and grounded, not delicate or feminine and not a glossy celebrity photo. Keep subtle facial asymmetry and expressive brush strokes so he belongs with the game's other portraits.
Invariants: Keep the existing distinct dark tied ponytail and swept forelock, hair volume, head angle, ear position, height and body proportions. Preserve the muted worn blue-grey cross-collar cloth robe, inner off-white collar, sash, plum-brown wrist guards, folds, both hands, standing pose and lower crop from image 2. No fancy costume, ornaments, new weapons, jewelry or scenery. Preserve rough black dry-brush contours, colored-pencil grain, opaque watercolor texture, slightly uneven lines, muted earthy palette, flat illustrated lighting and the original game's hand-painted aesthetic. Facial beauty must use the SAME coarse painted style as the robe. No smooth anime rendering, porcelain skin, makeup, eyeliner, 3D, photographic skin or airbrushed gradients.
Composition: EXACTLY ONE isolated character, full supplied silhouette including ponytail and both hands to the original lower crop, tightly framed vertical sprite with small transparent margin. Same canvas aspect ratio as image 2. Real transparent alpha background. No text, labels, grid, border, watermark or ground shadow.

normalFinal.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. EDIT this finished handsome Zhao Huo transparent game sprite.
